paragraphs: The Freelander eD4 was introduced as a more efficient, two-wheel-drive variant of the Freelander 2 (L359). It uses the Ford Duratorq 2.2-litre four-cylinder diesel engine. While the eD4 shares its engine family with the later SD4, it was offered as a separate, lower-emission model in the range. The Freelander 2 was discontinued in 2014, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Land Rover Freelander eD4 Engine Codes Ford Duratorq (L359) A 2.2-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the Freelander eD4 from 2006 to 2014 (L359 generation). Known for injector failure and DPF clogging over time — see the callout above. We replace injectors, the EGR valve and the timing belt as standard on every Duratorq rebuild. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Freelander eD4 from 2023 to present. The engine features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older engine V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every engine rebuild.
